# Database Deadlock Detection & Consistent Lock Ordering

Preventing database deadlocks: acquiring locks in globally deterministic alphabetical order, short transaction scopes, and retry loops.

## Invariants
- ACQUIRE_LOCKS_IN_IDENTICAL_SORTED_ORDER
- KEEP_TRANSACTION_TIMES_MINIMAL
- AUTOMATED_RETRY_ON_DEADLOCK_ERROR_CODE
